title: I think I finally found a decent AI tool for sprite sheets
author: Legitimate-Debt-2533
selftext:
I've been looking for a good way to make sprite sheets for a small game I'm working on, and I tried [Spritesheets.AI](http://Spritesheets.AI) today.



https://preview.redd.it/74g4q31ejkih1.png?width=10240&format=png&auto=webp&s=b43833d286b8aa0a1edcc46684a33a785c87dbb4

Honestly I wasn't expecting much from it, but the result surprised me. I made a character and tested the sprite sheet generation, and the character stayed pretty consistent across the frames. That's usually the part I have the most trouble with when using AI for game assets.



I'm still testing it, so I can't say yet if it's good enough for a full game production workflow, but for prototyping it looks pretty interesting.



I'm especially curious about how well it handles different animations like idle, walking, attacks and skills while keeping the same character.



Has anyone here tried it before? What tools are you guys using for sprite sheets right now?
